# SSO + 3 roles

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:console-sso-rbac` · **Epic:** [#30](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/30) · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

The control-plane console becomes an OIDC client of Dex. Humans sign in with auth code + PKCE, get a server-side session, and are mapped from IdP groups to admin, editor or viewer. Every dashboard write API checks the role. The shared bearer token stops working for human endpoints.

## How we build it

- New package `internal/cpstate`: one SQLite DB `<state-dir>/warden-cp.db` (modernc.org/sqlite, already a dependency) with a forward-only `schema_migrations` table. It holds sessions and the stores that later items add (versions, tokens, admin audit, block list). OIDC console mode requires `--state-dir`.
- CP-local config block `console:` (json:"-", never on the policy wire): `auth: none|oidc`, `oidc: {issuer, clientID, clientSecretEnv, redirectURL, scopes}`, `roles: {admin: [groups], editor: [groups], viewer: [groups]}`, `session: {idle: 8h, absolute: 24h}`. The highest matching role wins, and no match means 403 after login.
- Routes on the CP mux: `GET /auth/login` (state, nonce, S256 PKCE verifier kept in a cpstate `oidc_pending` row with 10 min TTL), `GET /auth/callback` (code exchange via golang.org/x/oauth2, ID token verified with the internal/identity verifier using aud=clientID, nonce checked), `POST /auth/logout`, and `GET /auth/me`.
- Session cookie `warden_session`: 32 random bytes, stored as a sha256 hash, HttpOnly, Secure (when TLS), SameSite=Lax. A per-session CSRF token must be echoed in `X-Warden-CSRF` on every non-GET request.
- Authz middleware wraps `dash.Handler()` and `/central/secrets` with a route table (method+path -> minimum role). GET is viewer. Policy/settings/detection writes are editor. Integrations, llmproviders, secrets, worker tokens and the block list are admin. A mutating route missing from the table is denied.
- `console.auth: none` keeps today's open dashboard for back-compat, but logs a startup warning and shows a banner. In `oidc` mode the shared token is rejected on `/central/secrets` and all `/dashboard/*` routes.

## Done when

With `console.auth: oidc`, an LDAP user in warden-viewers can read but gets 403 on POST /dashboard/api/policy, a warden-editors user can edit policy, only warden-admins can edit integrations, and the WARDEN_CP_TOKEN bearer no longer opens any dashboard or /central/secrets route.

### 1/6 · W-P1-SSO-01

**Add internal/cpstate SQLite state store with migrations**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#31](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/31)

Create new package `internal/cpstate` with `Open(path string) (*DB, error)`, a forward-only migration runner (`schema_migrations(version, applied_at)`), WAL mode, busy_timeout, and `Close`. In `cmd/proxy/controlplane.go`, open `<state-dir>/warden-cp.db` when `--state-dir` is set and pass it via a new `controlplane.Config.State` field. Migrations are registered per feature (a sessions table in this ticket). Opening is fail-closed: a corrupt DB stops startup with an actionable error.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Re-opening an existing DB applies only the new migrations, which is tested with two migration sets
- [ ] Concurrent writers from goroutines do not return SQLITE_BUSY under the race detector
- [ ] A CP without `--state-dir` starts as before when console.auth is none

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-SSO-03`](console-sso-rbac.md#36--w-p1-sso-03) Implement OIDC login/callback with PKCE on the control plane; [`W-P1-AAUD-01`](admin-audit-log.md#13--w-p1-aaud-01) Add signed, hash-chained admin audit store in cpstate; [`W-P1-PVER-01`](policy-versioning.md#14--w-p1-pver-01) Add versioned policy store and serve the head version; [`W-P1-WTOK-01`](worker-credentials.md#14--w-p1-wtok-01) Add worker token store with hashed storage and revocation; [`W-P1-OPS1-02`](ops-hardening.md#23--w-p1-ops1-02) Add scheduled SQLite backups and verified restore command

### 2/6 · W-P1-SSO-02

**Parse and validate the CP-local console config block**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#32](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/32)

Add `internal/config/console.go` with `ConsoleConfig{Auth, OIDC{Issuer, ClientID, ClientSecretEnv, RedirectURL, Scopes}, Roles{Admin, Editor, Viewer []string}, Session{Idle, Absolute}, BreakGlass}`. Wire it into rawConfig and Policy as `json:"-"` so it never rides policyWire or SettingsWire. Validation: in oidc mode the issuer must be https unless it is a loopback host or `allowInsecureIssuer` is set, clientSecretEnv must be set, and at least one admin group is required. Add an example to `configs/config.control-plane.yaml`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Unit tests cover the valid config, a missing admin group, and an http issuer being rejected
- [ ] A test asserts that the JSON of policyWire and SettingsWire never contains a `console` key

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-SSO-03`](console-sso-rbac.md#36--w-p1-sso-03) Implement OIDC login/callback with PKCE on the control plane

### 3/6 · W-P1-SSO-03

**Implement OIDC login/callback with PKCE on the control plane**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#33](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/33)

In `internal/controlplane`, add `auth.go` with handlers `/auth/login` and `/auth/callback`. It uses `github.com/coreos/go-oidc/v3` discovery and `golang.org/x/oauth2` with S256 PKCE, keeps state/nonce/verifier in a cpstate `oidc_pending` table (10 min TTL, single use), and verifies the ID token through the `internal/identity` verifier with aud=clientID. On success it hands claims to the session layer. Errors redirect to `/dashboard/?login_error=<code>` and never echo IdP error text unescaped.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] An httptest fake OIDC provider completes login end to end
- [ ] A replayed state, bad nonce, wrong aud, or expired token each fail with no session created
- [ ] A pending row is deleted after use and after its TTL

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-01`](console-sso-rbac.md#16--w-p1-sso-01) Add internal/cpstate SQLite state store with migrations; [`W-P1-SSO-02`](console-sso-rbac.md#26--w-p1-sso-02) Parse and validate the CP-local console config block; [`W-P1-VRFY-01`](identity-verification.md#15--w-p1-vrfy-01) Add internal/identity OIDC verifier with cached JWKS and config

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-SSO-04`](console-sso-rbac.md#46--w-p1-sso-04) Add server-side sessions, logout, /auth/me and CSRF

### 4/6 · W-P1-SSO-04

**Add server-side sessions, logout, /auth/me and CSRF**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#34](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/34)

Add a `sessions` table (`id_hash, sub, email, groups_json, role, auth_method, csrf, created_at, last_seen_at, expires_at`) and a `SessionStore` in internal/controlplane. Set the cookie `warden_session` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure when serving TLS). Enforce idle and absolute expiry, with last_seen writes throttled to once per minute. `POST /auth/logout` deletes the row. `GET /auth/me` returns `{sub,email,role,csrf}`. A middleware puts a `Principal` into the request context.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Sessions expire on idle and absolute limits under a fake clock
- [ ] Without an X-Warden-CSRF header matching the session, a POST is rejected with 403
- [ ] After logout the old cookie gets 401

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-03`](console-sso-rbac.md#36--w-p1-sso-03) Implement OIDC login/callback with PKCE on the control plane

### 5/6 · W-P1-SSO-05

**Map groups to roles and enforce role checks on dashboard APIs**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#35](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/35)

Compute the role at login from `console.roles` (admin > editor > viewer; no match means a 403 page). Add `authz.go` with a table of every route that `dashboard.Server.Handler()` and the CP mux register, giving method and minimum role, and wrap `/dashboard/` and `/central/secrets` with it. The dashboard `index.html` reads `/auth/me` and hides write controls above the user's role. A test enumerates the registered dashboard routes and fails when a route has no authz entry.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Each dashboard POST/PUT/DELETE route is checked for viewer -> 403, editor/admin -> allowed per the table
- [ ] A new unlisted mutating route is denied by default, and the route-coverage test catches it
- [ ] Role changes in the IdP take effect at next login, and this is documented

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-04`](console-sso-rbac.md#46--w-p1-sso-04) Add server-side sessions, logout, /auth/me and CSRF

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-SSO-06`](console-sso-rbac.md#66--w-p1-sso-06) Retire the shared bearer token for human-facing CP routes; [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers; [`W-P1-PVER-02`](policy-versioning.md#24--w-p1-pver-02) Migrate file-edit-in-place to versioned writes; [`W-P1-BLOCK-03`](user-block-list.md#33--w-p1-block-03) Add CP block-list store, admin API and dashboard UI; [`W-P1-WTOK-03`](worker-credentials.md#34--w-p1-wtok-03) Add worker token admin API, dashboard panel and bootstrap CLI

### 6/6 · W-P1-SSO-06

**Retire the shared bearer token for human-facing CP routes**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#36](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/36)

In oidc mode, `handleSecrets`/`handleSecretByKey` (`internal/controlplane/secrets.go`) require an admin session and no longer accept `Bearer <cfg.Token>`. The shared token stays valid only on `/policy`, `/control/heartbeat` and `/central/ingest` until per-worker tokens land. With `console.auth: none`, log a startup warning and return `authMode: none` from `/dashboard/api/setup` so the UI shows a banner. Update `docs/control-plane.md`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] In oidc mode, a request to /central/secrets with only the shared token returns 401
- [ ] In none mode, existing compose recipes behave unchanged and the warning is logged once

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-SSO-05`](console-sso-rbac.md#56--w-p1-sso-05) Map groups to roles and enforce role checks on dashboard APIs
